title: TQ-HQNet: A Trainability-Aware and Qubit-Efficient Hybrid Quantum Neural Network for Cross-Domain Learning on Heterogeneous Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.31908v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hybrid quantum neural networks are a promising direction for noisy intermediate-scale quantum computing, but their practical effectiveness is often limited by poor trainability, rigid circuit design, and weak robustness across heterogeneous real-world tasks. This paper proposes TQ-HQNet, a Trainability-Aware and Qubit-Efficient Hybrid Quantum Neural Network for cross-domain learning on heterogeneous data. The proposed framework combines three mechanisms: 1) adaptive latent compression to map domain-specific features into qubit-compatible representations, 2) trainability-aware search over compact variational circuit candidates, and 3) hybrid fusion of multiple shallow quantum experts to improve robustness without increasing qubit cost excessively. translated_abstract: 混合量子神经网络是含噪声中等规模量子计算（NISQ）中一个颇具前景的研究方向，但其实际效果往往受限于较差的可训练性、僵化的电路设计以及在异构真实任务上鲁棒性不足。本文提出了TQ-HQNet，一种面向异构数据跨领域学习的可训练性感知且量子比特高效的混合量子神经网络。该框架结合了三种机制：1）自适应潜在压缩，将特定领域的特征映射为量子比特兼容的表示；2）在紧凑的变分电路候选上进行可训练性感知的搜索；3）多个浅层量子专家的混合融合，在不显著增加量子比特成本的前提下提升鲁棒性。TQ-HQNet在四个公开数据集上进行了评估，涵盖神经系统疾病筛查、钓鱼攻击检测、金融走势预测和DNA序列分类。在所有领域中，所提出的（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了TQ-HQNet混合量子神经网络，通过自适应潜在压缩、可训练性感知的紧凑变分电路搜索和浅层量子专家混合融合三种机制，在保持量子比特高效的同时，显著提升了跨异构数据领域学习的可训练性与鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: TQ-HQNet, a trainability-aware and qubit-efficient hybrid quantum neural network, integrates adaptive latent compression, trainability-aware search over compact variational circuits, and hybrid fusion of shallow quantum experts to achieve robust cross-domain learning on heterogeneous data with minimal qubit cost.
